ritual.title: Puzzled 的每日流程
ritual.body: 一个产品日，一套共同题目。免费玩家与会员的流程完全一样，区别只在于开放多少款游戏。
ritual.step1Body: 免费轮换为所有人开放一款游戏。高级版则在同一套题目下开放全部 {count} 款游戏。
ritual.step2Body: 大部分游戏需要两到十分钟；设有难度选择的游戏可以让你热身，或挑战更难的题目。
ritual.step3Body: 每天完成一局即可延续连续记录，每项完成的成绩都经服务器核实后才计算。

faq.title: 开始之前
faq.body: 关于游戏目录的简短说明。

start.question: 应该从哪里开始？
start.answer: 先玩今日免费游戏 — 无需账户，也无需付费。其余游戏需要高级版才能开放。

rotation.question: 免费游戏如何轮换？
rotation.answer: 每天有一款游戏免费，并在香港时间午夜轮换。所有人在同一天玩同一款游戏。

premium.question: 高级版包括什么？
premium.answer: 同一套每日题目下的全部游戏、往期存档、更深入的统计，以及连续记录冻结。

account.question: 需要账户吗？
account.answer: 不需要。免费游戏可以访客身份游玩；有账户则可跨设备保留连续记录、成绩与统计。

share.question: 分享成绩会剧透吗？
share.answer: 不会。成绩卡只显示游戏、日期与你的解题图形，不会显示答案。

tips: 第一次猜的时候，先选没有重复字母的词，这样每一格都能带来新线索。
灰色字母已经可以排除，把剩下的次数留给还没试过的字母。
先把黄色字母移到其他位置，再在同一行加入新字母。

faq.question: Five 的一局怎么结束？
faq.answer: 每局有六次猜测机会。猜中答案或用完最后一次机会，该局就会结束，完成的记录由服务器核实。

faq.question: 每天的 Five 答案所有玩家都一样吗？
faq.answer: 是的。同一天所有玩家都使用同一个答案，并在香港时间午夜更新。

tips: 提交之前先看完全部十六个词，并记下可能同时符合两组的词。
「差一个」表示四个词中有三个正确，只需换掉其中一个词。
一开始觉得无法归类的词，往往就是最后一组的关键。

faq.question: Threads 允许几次失误？
faq.answer: 四次。每提交一次错误的组合就扣一次，用完四次该局就结束。

faq.question: Threads 的「差一个」是什么意思？
faq.answer: 你选的四个词中，有三个属于同一组，只有一个不属于，因此只需换掉其中一个词。

tips: List the shortest words you can build with the center letter before reaching for longer finds.
Repeat letters freely; a hive letter can appear more than once in a word.
Chase the pangram last, since using all seven letters adds a seven-point bonus.

faq.question: What counts as a pangram in Hive?
faq.answer: A word that uses all seven hive letters. Each one adds seven points on top of its letter count.

faq.question: How long does a Hive round take?
faq.answer: The catalog estimate is about five minutes, and the rank scale grows with every word you find.

tips: 先填最短的横向词，它的字母能为纵向提示提供线索。
遇到卡住的提示时，连续点同一格两次，即可从横向切换到纵向。
先跳过难缠的提示，让交叉的字母收窄可能的答案。

faq.question: 在 Mini Grid 如何切换横向和纵向？
faq.answer: 点选方格后再点一次即可切换方向，同一格可以对应横向和纵向两条提示。

faq.question: 完成一道 Mini Grid 需要多久？
faq.answer: 大约五分钟，方格够小，一次就能完成。

tips: 留意某个数字在某个宫格内是否只剩一格可能，那就是答案。
用笔记模式列出候选数字，一旦确定位置就立即清除。
若同一宫格内有两格拥有相同的两个候选数字，该宫格其他格子就不能再填这两个数字。

faq.question: 怎么知道 Sudoku 已经完成？
faq.answer: 每一行、每一列和每个 3×3 宫格都恰好包含 1 到 9 各一次；填满且没有冲突，这道题就完成了。

faq.question: Sudoku 有难度设置吗？
faq.answer: 有。简单、中等、困难会改变一开始已填好的格数，难度越高，需要自己推理的部分越多。

tips: Begin with the longest run in a line and test every position it can occupy.
Blocks longer than half the line have a middle section that must be filled in.
Mark squares you can rule out; fewer blanks make the crossing clues easier to read.

faq.question: How does Paint handle a wrong cell?
faq.answer: A filled square that cannot belong to the picture is rejected and added to the error count shown above the grid.

faq.question: How long does a Paint puzzle take?
faq.answer: The catalog estimate is around eight minutes for the 10×10 grid, and the clues get easier as the picture fills in.

tips: Change exactly one letter per step, and check that the new word sounds real before sending it.
Work backwards from the target word when the start has no obvious neighbor.
Plan the whole chain, because a word you have used cannot appear again.

faq.question: What counts as a valid step in Rungs?
faq.answer: Each step changes exactly one letter and must form a real word of the same length, or the game rejects the move.

faq.question: How long does a Rungs puzzle take?
faq.answer: The estimate is about three minutes, and the goal is the fewest steps rather than the fastest typing.

tips: Balance both sides before submitting; a guess that does not evaluate is rejected.
Lock the characters already in the right place and rebuild the equation around them.
Vary the operators you test early; the equation can use plus, minus, times or divide.

faq.question: How long is the hidden equation in Arithmo?
faq.answer: Eight characters, counting the digits, the operators and the single equals sign.

faq.question: How many tries does Arithmo allow?
faq.answer: Six guesses. Green marks a character in the right place, yellow means it appears elsewhere in the equation and gray means it is not used.

tips: Compare one property at a time, starting with the number of shapes on each card.
If two cards match on a property, the third card must match them too or the trio fails.
Cards inside a set you have already found are locked, so scan the untouched cards next.

faq.question: What makes three cards a set in Match?
faq.answer: For all four properties, shape, color, fill and count, the three cards must be either all the same or all different.

faq.question: How long does a Match board take?
faq.answer: The estimate is about four minutes, and the board holds twelve cards with several sets hidden among them.

tips: Clear the space under the target before nudging it toward the exit row.
Keep your move total low; a piece pushed into a corner is slow to rescue.
Reset a jammed board rather than testing moves at random; the minimum is shown for scale.

faq.question: How do I win a Slides puzzle?
faq.answer: Slide the red target block to the exit at the bottom edge; the round ends as soon as it reaches the gap.

faq.question: Does Slides offer difficulty settings?
faq.answer: Yes. Easy, medium and hard boards need more moves to solve as the level rises, from a short route to a long one.

tips: 排除每个皇冠周围的八格，因为这些格子不可能再放皇冠。
范围最小的区域最快确定，先从最小的区域入手。
当某一行或某一列已放好皇冠，该行或该列其余格子就视为不可用。

faq.question: Crowns 的目标是什么？
faq.answer: 每一行、每一列和每个颜色区域各放一个皇冠，而且任何两个皇冠都不能相邻，包括斜角。

faq.question: Crowns 有难度设置吗？
faq.answer: 有。简单为 5×5 棋盘，中等 6×6，困难 8×8，棋盘越大越需要推理。

tips: Two matching symbols side by side force the squares around them to hold the opposite one.
Tally each line as it grows: a row of six needs three suns and three moons.
Test a coin-flip square against the uniqueness rule, since no two rows may match.

faq.question: What are the rules of Duo?
faq.answer: Every row and column holds equal suns and moons, no line shows three matching symbols together, and no two lines repeat.

faq.question: How long does a Duo board take?
faq.answer: The estimate is about five minutes, and the 6×6 grid usually falls to a careful pass.

tips: End each word on a letter that opens a good next word, because the chain only moves forward.
Alternate sides inside every word; letters from the same side cannot sit next to each other.
Note the letters you still owe the box, as the final word tends to gather leftovers.

faq.question: How does the word chain work in Frame?
faq.answer: Each new word begins with the last letter of the previous word, and neighboring letters inside a word must come from different sides.

faq.question: When is a Frame puzzle solved?
faq.answer: When the chain has used every one of the twelve letters on the box; a shorter chain is the tidier result.

tips: Open with a spread of common letters, because one guess is scored across all four boards.
Track each yellow letter per board; it can occupy different spots in different words.
After a board is solved, save the remaining guesses for the words still open.

faq.question: How many guesses do I get in Quad?
faq.answer: Nine in total, and each guess is checked against all four boards at once.

faq.question: Does everyone play the same four words each day?
faq.answer: Yes. Everyone plays the same four words on the same day, and the set changes at midnight Hong Kong time.

tips: Find cages with only one possible split, such as two cells adding up to three.
Cage digits still obey Sudoku rows, columns and boxes, so cross off what the grid already holds.
Subtract a finished cage from the row, column and box it crosses to narrow other cells.

faq.question: What do the cages add to Cage Sudoku?
faq.answer: Each cage has a total: its digits must add up to that number, and no digit can repeat inside the cage.

faq.question: Does Cage Sudoku offer difficulty settings?
faq.answer: Yes. Easy, medium and hard differ in how many digits start filled in, and hard gives none at all.

tips: Start with a single-letter word, which can only stand for a or i in plain English.
Double letters leave fingerprints, so a repeated pair narrows the options quickly.
Update every occurrence of a letter once you decide it, keeping the mapping consistent.

faq.question: How do I know a Cipher quote is solved?
faq.answer: When the substitution is right, the decoded text reads as normal English and the puzzle reports the quote as solved.

faq.question: How long does a Cipher puzzle take?
faq.answer: The estimate is about five minutes, though longer quotes take more letters to place.

tips: Scan the theme first; the grid hides six to ten words that share a topic.
Check diagonals in both directions and rows read backwards, not just left to right.
Trace from the last letter back to the first when a long word is hard to spot.

faq.question: Which directions do hidden words run in Hunt?
faq.answer: Horizontal, vertical and diagonal, forwards or backwards, and always in a straight line.

faq.question: Does everyone get the same Hunt grid?
faq.answer: Yes. The daily grid and its theme are identical for every player and refresh at midnight Hong Kong time.

tips: Handle corner clues early, since a numbered corner cell has only two neighbors.
Count the squares between two known numbers; when the total matches, that route is forced.
Split the board at the numbered clues and solve each stretch separately.

faq.question: What counts as a finished Path?
faq.answer: A line that starts at 1, visits every cell exactly once, moves only between side-by-side cells and ends on the last number.

faq.question: How long does a Path puzzle take?
faq.answer: The estimate is about five minutes on a 6×6 board, and the printed clues handle much of the early deduction.

tips: Study the region labels first; a sum of zero pins that whole region to blank ends.
Regions marked with = take matching numbers, so place tiles that repeat a value there.
Remember that each tile covers two cells sharing a side, never a diagonal pair.

faq.question: How do the region rules work in Spots?
faq.answer: A number is that region's total of spots, = means every spot there matches and ≠ means they are all different.

faq.question: What has to be true when a Spots board is finished?
faq.answer: Every cell is covered once by the full set of tiles, each tile joins two cells that share a side, and every region rule holds.
